# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_config_reference.py; do not edit by hand. -->

This table is generated from `dalston.config.Settings`. It covers
gateway/orchestrator settings owned by that model. Engine-specific variables
remain documented with their engine or subsystem.

| Environment variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DALSTON_MODE` | `distributed` | Runtime mode. Explicit process-wide immutable mode switch. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql+asyncpg://dalston:password@localhost:5432/dalston` |  |
| `DALSTON_LITE_DATABASE_URL` | `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./.dalston/lite.db` |  |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis://localhost:6379` |  |
| `DALSTON_EVENTS_MAX_DELIVERIES` | `5` | Maximum number of delivery attempts for durable orchestrator events before they are moved to the DLQ |
| `DALSTON_EVENTS_DLQ_STREAM` | `dalston:events:dlq` | Redis stream key for dead-letter durable orchestrator events |
| `DALSTON_EVENTS_DLQ_MAXLEN` | `10000` | Approximate maximum length for the durable events DLQ stream (uses XADD MAXLEN ~) |
| `DALSTON_S3_BUCKET` | `dalston-artifacts` |  |
| `DALSTON_S3_REGION` | `eu-west-2` |  |
| `DALSTON_S3_ENDPOINT_URL` | unset |  |
| `DALSTON_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL` | unset | Browser-reachable S3/MinIO endpoint used for presigned download URLs. If unset, the backend uses DALSTON_S3_ENDPOINT_URL and local MinIO fallback logic. |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | unset |  |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | unset |  |
| `DALSTON_LITE_ARTIFACTS_DIR` | `./.dalston/artifacts` |  |
| `DALSTON_LITE_TRANSCRIBE_BACKEND` | `real` | Lite transcribe backend. 'real': execute a local engine engine_id (default). 'stub': use deterministic placeholder transcript. |
| `DALSTON_LITE_TRANSCRIBE_ENGINE_REF` | `engines/stt-transcribe/faster-whisper/batch_engine.py:FasterWhisperBatchEngine` | Engine reference used by lite transcribe backend when backend='real'. |
| `DALSTON_LITE_DIARIZE_BACKEND` | `real` | Lite diarize backend. 'real': execute a local engine engine_id (default). 'stub': use deterministic placeholder diarization. |
| `DALSTON_LITE_DIARIZE_ENGINE_REF` | `engines/stt-diarize/nemo-msdd/engine.py:NemoMSDDEngine` | Engine reference used by lite diarize backend when backend='real'. |
| `DALSTON_LITE_DIARIZE_RUNTIME_MODEL_ID` | `nvidia/diar-msdd-telephonic` | Default loaded_model_id injected into lite diarize config when omitted. |
| `DALSTON_LITE_VENV_PYTHON` | unset | Python executable used for lite venv engine_ids. Defaults to the current interpreter when unset. |
| `DALSTON_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `dalston-webhook-secret-change-me` | Default HMAC secret for signing webhook payloads (used for endpoints without custom secrets) |
| `DALSTON_RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` | `600` | Maximum API requests per minute per tenant |
| `DALSTON_RATE_LIMIT_CONCURRENT_JOBS` | `10` | Maximum concurrent batch transcription jobs per tenant |
| `DALSTON_RATE_LIMIT_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS` | `5` | Maximum concurrent realtime sessions per tenant |
| `DALSTON_RETENTION_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `300` | Interval between cleanup worker sweeps |
| `DALSTON_RETENTION_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE` | `100` | Maximum jobs to purge per cleanup sweep |
| `DALSTON_RETENTION_DEFAULT_DAYS` | `30` | Default retention in days when not specified (30 = 30 days) |
| `DALSTON_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE_BEHAVIOR` | `fail_fast` | Behavior when a required engine is not running. 'fail_fast': fail immediately with error (default). 'wait': queue task and wait for engine to start. |
| `DALSTON_ENGINE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `300` | Maximum time to wait for an engine to start (only used when engine_unavailable_behavior='wait'). Task fails if engine doesn't pick it up within this timeout. |
| `DALSTON_TASK_STALE_TIMEOUT_S` | `1800` | Wait timeout for tasks whose engine was selected on-demand with zero live instances (M91 scale-to-zero). Sized for several autoscaler ticks + spot launch + model cold boot; the job fails with an explicit 'no worker became available' error after this. |
| `DALSTON_AUDIO_URL_MAX_SIZE_GB` | `3.0` | Maximum audio file size for URL downloads in GB |
| `DALSTON_AUDIO_URL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | `300` | Timeout for downloading audio from URLs in seconds |
| `DALSTON_DEFAULT_MODEL` | `Systran/faster-whisper-base` | Default transcription model for OpenAI/ElevenLabs compatible APIs |
| `DALSTON_REALTIME_MIN_SILENCE_DURATION_MS` | `400` | Default silence duration (ms) to trigger utterance end in realtime sessions |
| `DALSTON_REALTIME_MAX_UTTERANCE_DURATION` | `30.0` | Default max utterance duration (seconds) before forcing chunk in realtime sessions |
| `DALSTON_SECURITY_MODE` | `api_key` | Security mode: 'none' (no auth checks, dev only), 'api_key' (API key validation), 'user' (future user auth) |

## Mode-specific behavior

`DALSTON_MODE=lite` changes the retention default to `0` only when
`DALSTON_RETENTION_DEFAULT_DAYS` was not explicitly supplied. It also selects
the SQLite/local-artifact dependencies described by the Lite capability API.

`DALSTON_SECURITY_MODE=none` is intended only for trusted local development.
Change `DALSTON_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and example database/object-storage credentials
before any non-local deployment.

## Other subsystem variables

Some runtime settings are intentionally not part of the central Pydantic
model:

- Model source/cache: `DALSTON_MODEL_SOURCE`, `DALSTON_MODEL_CACHE_DIR`,
  `DALSTON_MODEL_CACHE_MAX_GB`, `DALSTON_MODEL_CACHE_TTL_HOURS`, and
  `DALSTON_MODEL_CACHE_SCAN_INTERVAL`.
- Realtime lag: `DALSTON_REALTIME_LAG_WARNING_SECONDS`,
  `DALSTON_REALTIME_LAG_HARD_SECONDS`, and
  `DALSTON_REALTIME_LAG_HARD_GRACE_SECONDS`.
- Optional batch speech-region diagnostics:
  `DALSTON_PREPARE_SPEECH_REGIONS`.
- Engine/device credentials and tuning, including `HF_TOKEN`,
  `DALSTON_DEVICE`, and engine-specific batch/concurrency variables.

Use `.env.example`, the relevant engine's `engine.yaml`/README, and code search
for subsystem settings. Never copy credentials from a development `.env` into
cloud deployment shells.
